questions.stem: A 26-year-old female patient presents to OPD with an inability to focus on close objects over the previous few hours. However, she reports that she can see distant objects. On examination, she can move her eyes normally. Which of the following structures is most likely damaged in such a condition?

options.label: B
options.text: Oculomotor nerve and long ciliary nerve

options.label: C
options.text: Short ciliary nerves and ciliary ganglion
